title: Horizontal displacement BC
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the horizontal displacement BC using projectile motion equations.

title: Velocity at point E
description: Essential: Correctly determines the block's speed at point E using energy or dynamics, accounting for friction.

title: Conveyor belt speed condition
description: Essential: States the correct inequality for the conveyor belt's clockwise speed to deliver the block to F.

title: Time range E to F
description: Essential: Provides the correct time interval for the block to travel from E to F.

title: Projectile motion setup
description: Important: Applies kinematic equations correctly for the projectile phase to find time of flight.

title: Force analysis at E
description: Important: Correctly calculates the normal force at E using the given friction force and coefficient.

title: Conveyor belt dynamics
description: Important: Distinguishes and applies Newton's second law for both acceleration cases (block speed relative to belt).

title: Kinematic phases on EF
description: Important: Breaks the motion on the incline into correct accelerated/decelerated or uniform segments.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for friction force relative to motion on the incline.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s) throughout calculations.
